QuestInfo.name: [Omega Sector] I Think We Took a Wrong Turn
QuestInfo.0: Look inside the air vents in Corridor 204.
QuestInfo.1: The air vents are full of Mecateons. You need to reduce their numbers while the M-Forcers search the air vents.
QuestInfo.2: Corridor 204's air vents didn't lead where you hoped. Check the next one on the list.
